other_details: Join our mission to build life-saving medical technologies with precision, passion and purpose. Key Responsibilities: Manage day-to-day cleanroom manufacturing operations including PTCA catheter assembly, stent coating, stent crimping, braiding, coiling, lamination, and catheter sub-assembly processes. Execute production plans to achieve quality, delivery, productivity, and yield targets while ensuring optimal utilization of manpower & resources. Ensure strict adherence to SOPs, Work Instructions, BMR, DHR, and cleanroom practices. Monitor process performance, identify bottlenecks, and drive improvements in productivity, yield, cycle time, and operational efficiency. Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and coordinate with Quality, Engineering, R&D and Maintenance teams for effective resolution. Manage and develop production teams through planning, training, and performance management. Support process validation, NPI, scale-up activities and continuous improvement initiatives. Drive Lean practices including 5S, Kaizen, waste reduction and standard work implementation. Maintain production records, review KPIs and report on output, yield, rejection, downtime and productivity. Coordinate with Supply Chain & Stores to ensure timely availability of materials & consumables. Promote a culture of quality, accountability, safety and continuous improvement. Role Overview: Lead and scale our cleanroom manufacturing operations, ensuring quality, efficiency and on-time delivery across PTCA catheter assembly, stent coating, stent crimping, braiding, coiling, lamination and catheter sub-assembly processes. Lead teams, optimize processes and drive continuous improvement in a regulated ISO 13485 environment. Key Highlights: Lead Cleanroom Manufacturing Operations, Drive Quality, Productivity & Yield, Ensure Compliance (ISO 13485, GMP), Develop & Mentor High-Performance Teams, Drive Continuous Improvement (Lean, 5S, Kaizen). Ideal Candidate: Local candidate from Mysore or nearby locations with long-term stability. Strong shop-floor orientation and ability to manage daily production challenges. Exposure to Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPIM, SPC and Six Sigma methodologies. Collaborative mindset to work with cross-functional teams. Candidates from automotive, electronics, aerospace, precision engineering or similar industries preferred. Ownership mindset with focus on quality, productivity, delivery and team development. Experience in industries such as: Automotive components, Electronics manufacturing, Aerospace components, Precision engineering, Semiconductor / EMS manufacturing, Medical devices / Pharma manufacturing.
